Khazix.summary: Kha'Zix will invade and try to catch you isolated early. Place deep wards and avoid 1v1s before level 6 unless you know his leap is on cooldown.

Evelynn.summary: Do not let her hit level 6 uncontested. Pick up some magic resist early and use Control Wards to reveal her before she can burst you.

Shaco.summary: The author's standard ban since Shaco is frustrating and often played by one-tricks. Track him from the start, stay clear of his boxes, and punish him once his early cheese fails, since he duels poorly afterward.

Elise.summary: Elise dominates the early game. Focus on surviving and farming inside warded areas until she falls off, then your scaling takes over.

Rammus.summary: Never fight him while his W is up. Wait for him to use his taunt, then lean on Q resets and true damage to get through his armor.

Fiddlesticks.summary: Ward the corners of your jungle and around objectives. If you avoid his ultimate engage, he is an easy kill.

Vi.summary: Her early ganks and targeted ultimate demand respect. Once you have tenacity and damage items she falls off sharply.

Belveth.summary: With good farm and resets she can beat you in clear speed and skirmishes. Deny her early tempo so she cannot snowball.

RekSai.summary: Her map presence and tunnels make early invades dangerous. Play safe and avoid being caught out of position.

Jax.summary: Long late-game duels tend to favour Jax. Hit your item spikes on time and do not let him scale freely.

Pantheon.summary: Pantheon crushes you before level 6. Kite him or stay away from him until your first completed item.

Gragas.summary: His CC and burst can wreck your engages. Wait until he has used his E or ultimate before going all in.

Poppy.summary: A hard early counter. Track her W cooldown so you can escape fights with Alpha Strike or Flash when it is down.

MonkeyKing.summary: Wukong can beat you early and interrupt resets with his knock-ups. If you reach two items, you outscale him comfortably in longer fights.

Kayn.summary: Keep farm even and avoid giving early kills. If you hit your two-item spike first, you beat either of his forms.

Graves.summary: Fighting him head-on lets him kite you forever. Flank him or Q over walls when his dash is on cooldown to close the distance.

LeeSin.summary: Lee Sin pressures hard early. Survive that phase without taking risks and you take over later.

Ekko.summary: His burst and mobility can dodge your resets if you engage carelessly. Played patiently, you outscale him in most games.

Warwick.summary: His early sustain and fear can wreck your duels. Wait out his early pressure and punish once you have items.

Viego.summary: He is like a smaller Yi with crowd control. Avoid giving him early resets; if you get ahead, you outscale him.

Zac.summary: Do not burn Alpha Strike on his slingshot engage. Kill his blobs quickly so he cannot revive.

Kindred.summary: Deny her marks with deep wards and fast clears. Once you are ahead, your damage kills her even through her ultimate.

Amumu.summary: You farm freely early, but he is dangerous in teamfights. Engage only after he misses his Q or uses his ultimate.

Diana.summary: Diana wins early skirmishes but falls off. Dodge her pull engage and you win drawn-out fights.

Trundle.summary: Do not duel him next to his pillar, and wait for him to use his ultimate first, or he will drain your stats.

Rengar.summary: Vision is the key. Fight only after he uses his leap or ultimate, and stay in tight spaces where his burst is less effective.

Nidalee.summary: She outdamages you before level 6, so avoid early skirmishes. Farm efficiently and catch her when she overextends.

Sejuani.summary: Her chained CC breaks your resets. Bait out her Q or ultimate before committing.

Olaf.summary: Avoid early river fights since he wins before items. Once you have lifesteal and your ultimate, you flip the duel.

Morgana.summary: Her root and W zone slow you down. Use your ultimate to run through and kill her before she can CC you again.

Qiyana.summary: She is deadly in the river, so ward and fight away from walls. Punish her if she wastes her combo.

Lillia.summary: Her kiting and speed are annoying early. Get early boots or a red buff advantage so you can stick to her.

Rumble.summary: His skirmishing and burn zones beat you before items. Avoid fights in jungle corridors and wait until you have sustain.

Gwen.summary: Hard early, even later. Never fight inside her mist, and use your range and true damage once you are scaled.

Skarner.summary: His ultimate can lock you out of a fight if you dive in blindly. Build QSS or Mercury's Treads and wait for him to use it on someone else.

Ivern.summary: Ivern cannot kill you, so this is a free farming game. Invade early and take over his jungle.

Udyr.summary: Early duels are risky. Kite back until your ultimate and E true damage let you outdamage him.

Talon.summary: Respect his early invade. He falls off quickly once you have armor and sustain from Blade of the Ruined King.

Hecarim.summary: Avoid fights before two items. With Blade of the Ruined King and Guinsoo's, you shred him if he misses his ultimate.

Nocturne.summary: Keep farm even and respect his level 6 ultimate. From mid game on, your damage and ultimate outclass him.

Nunu.summary: He cannot kill you but will win early objectives. Counter-farm his jungle and punish ganks that fail.

JarvanIV.summary: Hold your Q for when he tries to trap you with his ultimate; Alpha Strike lets you escape his combo.

Volibear.summary: He wins 1v1s before level 6. After that, dodge his stun and shred him with true damage once you have attack speed items.

Briar.summary: Strong early duelist. When she overcommits, back off until her frenzy runs out, then turn on her with ultimate resets.

Mordekaiser.summary: His ultimate can isolate you. Build QSS or wait for him to spend it on someone else before diving.

Sylas.summary: Respect his early skirmishing and avoid letting him steal your ultimate in teamfights.

Taliyah.summary: Stay away from walls to avoid her knockback. If you reach her with Q, she dies before she can kite.

Maokai.summary: Do not fight him early. Farm up and shred him later with true damage.

Brand.summary: Very squishy but bursty. Dodge his stun combo with Alpha Strike and you can kill him before he ults.

Zed.summary: He invades hard early, but once you buy any sustain item he cannot keep up with your damage.

XinZhao.summary: Avoid him before level 6, when his knock-up and dueling are lethal. You beat him comfortably later on.

Shyvana.summary: Outfarm her and skip early fights. Once both of you have scaled, your true damage beats her burn.

Karthus.summary: He aims to outfarm you, so invade early and punish him before he scales; you win melee duels easily.

Naafiri.summary: Her packmates can block your autos early. Use Q to target her directly and dodge her bite combo.
